如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    一番仪式之后，许紫烟等人算是正式进入了外堂。第二天各自收拾好自己的行礼，在操场上集合，离开了学院进入了外堂。
每个人分了一个小院落，许紫烟很快地将自己的房子打扫干净，坐在屋子里的床上寻思着，自己虽然修为要比这次进入到外堂的弟子高，但是自己的基础未必就比他们高，恐怕还略有不如。毕竟人家是从三岁就开始系统地学习，而自己从修炼到现在也不过几个月的时间。
低着头想了想，便从自己的包裹里找出了几样自己买的胭脂水粉，用纸包好，提着走出了院门。她记着在她的隔壁也住着一个女孩，想着自己前往拜访一下，以后相互也能够交流一下。
谁知道令许紫烟哭笑不得的是，隔壁的女孩很是冷淡，许紫烟带去的胭脂水粉倒是毫不客气地收下了，也和许紫烟聊了几句，但是一但聊到修行方面的东西，便躲闪着话题，不肯和许紫烟交流。无奈之下，许紫烟只好告辞，郁闷地回到了自己的屋子。
“唉~~”
回到了屋子里，想起刚才的事，许紫烟重重地叹了一口气，摇了摇头想道：
“看来这个世界的人也是封闭得很啊，不肯和别人交流啊！早知道如此，那些胭脂水粉还不如留着自己用呢！”
从包裹中拿出符纸，符笔和朱砂，将符纸平铺在桌子上，把朱砂磨好，提起符笔，将心境放平，默运真气，将自己炼气期第二层的修为运至巅峰。体内的灵气从符笔中均匀地透露出来，笔走龙蛇，一气呵成。
放下符笔，将纸符拿在手中细细端量，符纸上华彩流动，许紫烟心中大喜，她制符的技术终于突破了一品，达到了二品中等的水平。谨慎地将这张二品水雷符收好，然后想再制作几张一品的纸符交给家族作为自己的任务。
许紫烟当然不会将自己能够制作二品符箓的事情告知家族，熟话说，一个弱小的人太富有的话，并不是一件好事。同样一个修为低下的人，却拥有着高超的制符本领，对于许紫烟来说也不是一件好事。
可是就在此时，许紫烟听到了敲门声。心里想着外面会是谁？将桌子上的东西快速地收拾好，然后整理一下衣衫，向着门口走去。
个同学。想眼前的这三男一女当初还不屑地看过许紫烟。许紫烟心中一愣，不知道他们为什么会来到自己这里，但是既然来了就是客人，许紫烟十分客气地请四个人进屋，但是对方却微笑着摇了摇头，其中那个叫作许丽的女孩清脆地说道：
“紫烟，我们是一个班级进入外堂的同学，不如我们今天一起出去找个饭馆庆祝一下吧。”
此时的四个人的神色上早已经没有倨傲，反而带着期盼。许紫烟起初一愣，迅即高兴了起来，原本她对家族的情况就不熟悉，刚才还想要和隔壁的女孩交流一下，只不过人家没有搭理她。如今有人前来相邀，许紫烟如何会不答应。
几个人都知道对方的名字，三个男的分别是许铁牛，许凌，许德志。又都是同一学院同一个班出来的人，自然就很快熟悉了起来，闹闹嚷嚷地走了出去。
“紫烟，你好厉害啊，十天前见到你还是后天第四层，没有想到昨天的测试你竟然是后天第六层的修为，你究竟是怎么修炼的？”
许丽首先忍不住这两日一直存在心中的疑问，急急地问了出来。许紫烟苦笑不已，这个问题她也一直想着怎么能够圆过去，可是想了很久也没有想出一个好的办法，如今被人问道了面前，只好支吾着说道：
“可能是我厚积薄发吧，一不小心就跳了一级，突破到第六层了。”
许丽四人偷偷撇了撇嘴，心道：“一不小心？我怎么就没有这样一不小心过？”
看着四个人明显地不相信的模样，许紫烟只好再次苦笑道：“我知道这件事有些诡异，可是我也不知道这是为什么？我还是头一次碰到，自己也吓了一跳。”

几个人看着许紫烟的神色不像是说谎，相互对视了一眼，许铁牛瓮声瓮气地说道：
“紫烟这么说就一定是这么回事，大家都不要瞎猜了。”
剩下的三个人的神色都有些尴尬，一时间都沉默了下来。但是毕竟这些人都是十五岁的年纪，很快就忘记了刚才的事情，又嬉闹到了一处。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author’s copyright complaint fast track. After a ceremony, Xu Ziyan and others officially entered the outer hall. The next day, everyone packed up their gifts, gathered on the playground, left the academy and entered the outer hall.
Each person was assigned a small courtyard. Xu Ziyan quickly cleaned his house and sat on the bed in the house, thinking that although his cultivation was higher than that of the disciples who entered the outer hall this time, his foundation was not necessarily higher than theirs. I am afraid he is still slightly inferior. After all, he has been studying systematically since he was three years old, and it has only been a few months since he started practicing.
He lowered his head and thought for a while, then found a few rouge and gouache he bought from his package, wrapped them in paper, and carried them out of the courtyard. She remembered that there was also a girl living next door to her, and thought that she would pay a visit so that they could communicate with each other in the future.
Who knew that what made Xu Ziyan dumbfounded was that the girl next door was very cold. The rouge and gouache that Xu Ziyan brought was accepted without ceremony. She also chatted with Xu Ziyan for a few words, but once she talked about spiritual practice, she avoided the topic and refused to communicate with Xu Ziyan. In desperation, Xu Ziyan had to say goodbye and returned to his house depressedly.
"Alas~~"
Back in the house, thinking of what happened just now, Xu Ziyan sighed heavily, shook his head and thought:
"It seems that people in this world are also very closed-minded and unwilling to communicate with others! If I had known this, I might as well have kept those rouge and gouache for my own use!"
Take out the talisman paper, talisman pen and cinnabar from the package, lay the talisman paper flat on the table, polish the cinnabar, lift up the talisman pen, calm down your mind, silently use your true energy, and bring your second-level cultivation to the peak of Qi refining period. The spiritual energy in the body is evenly revealed from the talisman pen, and the pen moves like a dragon and a snake in one go.
Putting down the talisman pen, she took the paper talisman in her hand and measured it carefully. The talisman paper was flowing with brilliant colors. Xu Ziyan was overjoyed. Her talisman-making technology finally broke through the first level and reached the intermediate level of the second level. He carefully put away this second-grade water and thunder talisman, and then wanted to make a few more first-grade paper talismans and give them to the family as his own task.
Of course Xu Ziyan will not tell his family that he can make second-grade talismans. As the saying goes, it is not a good thing for a weak person to be too rich. It is not a good thing for Xu Ziyan that the same person with low cultivation level has superb talisman making skills.
But at this moment, Xu Ziyan heard a knock on the door. Wondering who could be outside? He quickly packed away the things on the table, straightened his clothes, and walked towards the door.
A classmate. I remember that the three men and one woman in front of me had looked at Xu Ziyan with disdain. Xu Ziyan was stunned and didn't know why they came to him, but since they were guests, Xu Ziyan invited four people into the house very politely, but the other party smiled and shook his head. The girl named Xu Li said crisply:
"Zi Yan, we are classmates who entered the outer hall in the same class. Why don't we go out to a restaurant to celebrate together today."
At this time, the expressions of the four people no longer looked arrogant, but looked forward to it. Xu Ziyan was stunned at first, but soon became happy. She was not familiar with the family situation. She wanted to communicate with the girl next door just now, but she didn't pay attention to her. Now that someone came to invite him, how could Xu Ziyan not agree?
Several people knew each other's names. The three men were Xu Tieniu, Xu Ling and Xu Dezhi. They were all from the same college and the same class, so they naturally became familiar with each other quickly and walked out noisily.
"Zi Yan, you are so amazing. Ten days ago I saw you at the fourth level of the day after tomorrow. I didn't expect that in yesterday's test you were at the sixth level of the day after tomorrow. How did you practice?"Xu Li first couldn't help but ask the question that had been in her mind for the past two days and asked it urgently. Xu Ziyan smiled bitterly. She had been thinking about how to solve this problem, but after thinking for a long time, she could not come up with a good solution. Now that she was asked, she could only hesitate and said:
"Maybe I have accumulated a lot of experience, but accidentally jumped a level and broke through to the sixth level."
Xu Li and the other four secretly curled their lips and thought to themselves: "Accidentally? Why haven't I been so careless?"
Looking at the four people who obviously didn't believe it, Xu Ziyan had to smile bitterly again: "I know this thing is a bit weird, but I don't know why? This is the first time I encountered it, and I was shocked."
Several people looked at Xu Ziyan and looked at each other as if he was lying. Xu Tieniu said angrily:
"That's what Zi Yan said. That's what happened. Please stop guessing."
The remaining three people looked a little embarrassed and fell silent for a while. But after all, these people were all fifteen years old. They quickly forgot what happened just now and started playing again.
